beta_release_decision.target: 0.1.0.beta.1 after all assigned beta exit criteria pass
blockers: Root CI lint command has unresolved repository-wide offenses.
Independent generated-host CRUD, relationship, dashboard, and browser evidence is incomplete.
Remote CI history has not established passing blocking compatibility lanes.
Provider/security, response/audit, lifecycle, field, action, and AI production evidence remains companion-only or incomplete.

capabilities.name: resource_query_pipeline
guarantees: authenticated actor required
tenant scope before policy scope
whitelisted filters and sort fields
bounded pagination

capabilities.name: crud_mutation_pipeline
guarantees: explicit action authorization
record tenant access check
audit event required after successful persistence
normalized HTML, JSON, and Turbo Stream responses
generic resource controller supplies convention-based CRUD plumbing and route helpers

capabilities.name: generic_resource_rendering
guarantees: engine-owned index, new, edit, and show templates render when a host resource template is absent
singular and plural resource labels are configurable
list, form, and show fields default to permitted scalar attributes and can be explicitly configured
host resource templates remain intentional action-level overrides
capabilities.evidence_gap: A disposable generated Rails host has not yet proved boot, request, and system behavior.

capabilities.name: nested_association_editors
guarantees: declared child field allowlist and maximum row limit
keyboard-accessible Stimulus add and remove controls without jQuery
parent-association child ID lookup before assignment
child tenant and action checks reject crafted cross-tenant IDs
atomic Active Record parent-child persistence with retained nested validation rows
affected child identifiers in parent audit metadata
capabilities.evidence_gap: The demo Rails host covers Passenger create, validation, add, remove, and cross-tenant rejection; a separately generated Car/Passenger host plus has_one and nested belongs_to support remain pending.

capabilities.name: provider_contracts_and_security_baseline
guarantees: authentication, tenant, authorization, audit, and notification interfaces are validated at boot
missing or malformed provider configuration raises a deterministic configuration error
authorization provider denials and exceptions prevent queries and mutations
the companion uses explicit local provider adapters
generated-host documentation defines session, CSRF, cookie, header, redaction, tenant, and super-admin requirements
capabilities.evidence_gap: An independently generated Rails host must still prove boot-time configuration failure before serving protected resources.

capabilities.name: mutation_response_and_transactional_audit
guarantees: controller mutations use one normalized response adapter
JSON responses use data, errors, and outcome keys with mapped statuses
Turbo Stream responses select operation-specific success and error templates
Active Record audit failures roll back the parent mutation
a successful retry after audit recovery produces one effective event
capabilities.evidence_gap: An independently generated Rails host must exercise each mutation outcome in every response format.

capabilities.name: resource_query_lifecycle
guarantees: resource metadata declares includes and preloads after tenant and policy scoping
archive-aware resources default to active records and safely accept active, archived, and all states
configured DELETE requests create audited archive mutations while restore requires an explicit policy
the companion relationship editor verifies one passenger query for multiple rendered rows
capabilities.evidence_gap: An independently generated Rails host must prove archive, restore, eager loading, and invalid query behavior.

capabilities.name: field_level_authorization
guarantees: field read and write decisions deny by default when missing, false, or raising
read-denied fields are omitted from generic presentation, mutation JSON, AI context, and dashboard table column selection
readable write-denied form controls are disabled with an accessible explanation
forged scalar and declared nested field writes fail before persistence and audit
HTML, JSON, and Turbo Stream use the standard forbidden response contract
capabilities.evidence_gap: An independently generated Rails host must prove field decisions across role-specific presentation, nested relationships, dashboards, AI, and any future export selection.

capabilities.name: resource_actions_and_transitions
guarantees: resource-declared actions and state transitions require matching action authorization
tenant, provider, and declared field-write checks run before action handlers
successful actions persist and audit through the mutation transaction
generic show controls use the same endpoint authorization decision
HTML, JSON, and Turbo Stream use the normalized mutation response contract
capabilities.evidence_gap: An independently generated Rails host must prove permitted, forbidden, invalid-state, and cross-tenant action behavior.

capabilities.name: dashboard_lifecycle_and_drill_downs
guarantees: widgets register a resource, relation factory, explicit visibility predicate, and optional allowlisted drill-down filters
missing, false, or exception-producing visibility decisions hide a widget
ready, empty, error, and loading states are normalized without exposing internal errors
table rows serialize only field-readable columns and use bounded pagination
companion Turbo refresh renders the same scoped widget lifecycle
capabilities.evidence_gap: An independently generated Rails host must prove visible and hidden widgets, filtered drill-downs, state rendering, and table pagination.

capabilities.name: hotwire_ui_foundations
guarantees: no jQuery runtime dependency
light, dark, and system theme modes
inline Lucide SVG icons with resource-level icon configuration
engine default admin shell with host-configured, access-context-filtered navigation and fail-closed visibility or active predicates
install generator manages all engine import-map pins without overwriting host pins
desktop rail collapse persists locally; mobile drawer starts closed and closes on navigation, backdrop, or Escape with synchronized accessible toggle state
documented engine components for status, empty, field, filter, table, pagination, and record-detail states
generic resource pages use field-policy-aware components for empty, validation-error, disabled, notice, alert, and text-labelled status treatments
pagination retains only allowlisted resource query parameters
deterministic authenticated companion screenshots across light/dark desktop, tablet, and mobile states with heading, icon, and overflow assertions
Selenium headless Chrome companion suite runs in CI with screenshot artifact upload and a zero-retry flake budget
visible focus, named form controls, minimum touch-target, and reduced-motion support
semantic action button variants distinguish neutral, create, edit, save, and destructive controls, with default labelled actions paired with Lucide icons
capabilities.evidence_gap: An independently generated Rails host must prove a menu of at least ten authorized resources and default-shell index, new, edit, and show states across light, dark, and system modes at 1440px, 768px, and 390px with accessibility and reduced-motion assertions; screen-reader review and portable pixel-diff baselines remain pending.

capabilities.name: generator_contracts
guarantees: idempotent generated files, managed resource action requires, routes, and dashboard declarations
documentation-only sync preserves runtime host artifacts and content outside managed instruction markers
Rails inflection supplies resource filenames, constants, and routes
generated host registries retain host metadata while recording enabled modules and secret-free provider binding slots
generated resource scaffolds use authenticated deny-by-default policies and Rails integration-test conventions
capabilities.evidence_gap: A clean independently created Rails host must prove generated resource rendering and full CRUD/action/dashboard authorization behavior, including collision cases beyond managed files.

capabilities.name: policy_aware_dashboard_widgets
guarantees: tenant scope before policy scope
no precomputed aggregate input
table widgets use sorting and bounded pagination

capabilities.name: showcase_admin_panel
guarantees: lightweight and full install modes with a version-locked showcase manifest
full mode supplies seeded two-tenant, support-agent and manager action/transition scenarios
full mode validates generic resource CRUD/filter scope, audited mutations, and lifecycle dashboard relation output in a disposable companion host
CI runs static manifest checks and the disposable full showcase host verifier
capabilities.evidence_gap: A separately created clean host and stable browser suite must still prove full presentation, navigation, association editing, and AI walkthroughs.

capabilities.name: in_app_ai_assistant
guarantees: tenant and policy-scoped allowlisted context
read-only default
explicit approval required for mutation-capable requests
traced provider outputs and rejected tool calls

capabilities.name: production_ai_provider_routing_and_trace_operations
guarantees: missing, malformed, and exception-producing task-specific providers fail closed with a safe traced provider_failed result
provider tool calls remain restricted to the V1 read-only allowlist unless an explicit approval policy authorizes a traced mutation proposal
reference retained traces bind to a tenant, redact output by default, and limit search/export to safe metadata
capabilities.evidence_gap: No durable trace/operation store, persisted queued/running lifecycle, authenticated trace controller, Turbo progress/fallback UI, browser/request delivery evidence, or production provider adapter exists yet.

capabilities.name: ai_v11_reviewable_analysis
guarantees: structured extraction produces a non-persisting pending-review draft with evidence and a scoped-context fingerprint
every multi-source input independently applies tenant, policy, and AI field allowlists
cross-record and dashboard analysis run read-only and reject unsafe provider tool calls
prompt templates are bound to their declared task
capabilities.evidence_gap: No durable draft store, reviewer confirmation UI, request/browser proof, document attachment adapter, or provider-specific structured-output validation exists yet.

capabilities.name: ai_v2_approved_automation
guarantees: automation requires an approval policy returning exactly true before scoped target lookup or mutation
approved tool execution traces actor, roles, tenant, operation, target identifier, and source-context fingerprint before the mutation
target records resolve through the canonical tenant and policy-scoped relation and mutations use MutationPipeline
capabilities.evidence_gap: No durable reviewed-proposal store, escalation workflow, guided-workflow UI, outbox/retry recovery implementation, authenticated request/browser proof, or multi-source provider adapter exists yet.

capabilities.name: legacy_migration_and_1_0_release_contract
guarantees: a Ripper-backed audit maps recognized legacy resource constants without modifying host code
the audit emits actionable manual-review warnings and exits non-zero for unsupported automatic translations
the migration guide provides a direct Car/Passenger has_many recipe and an executable host validation checklist
the 1.0 release gate requires beta closure, migration evidence, compatibility, security review, rollback ownership, and release approval
capabilities.evidence_gap: No independently migrated legacy Car/Passenger host, runtime compatibility shim/deprecation warning, codemod rewrite, remote CI evidence, or approved beta/1.0 release exists yet.

capabilities.name: import_export_and_large_data_operations
guarantees: exports apply tenant, policy, archive, filter, sort, and field-read controls before optional per-field masking
exports intentionally exclude ordinary index pagination
imports validate mapped permitted and writable fields without persisting during preview
accepted import rows execute through the mutation and audit pipeline
Active Record audit or row failure rolls back the enclosing import
capabilities.evidence_gap: No authenticated controller/UI endpoint, browser/request delivery evidence, durable atomic idempotency-operation store, or persisted background-job retry contract exists yet. A bare fetch/record store is not crash-safe after commit.

capabilities.name: observability_and_governance
guarantees: request, mutation, audit, and AI completion events share a correlation ID
structured logs, ActiveSupport notifications, metric tags, and tracing payloads redact tenant, field, audit, and AI-sensitive values
telemetry adapter failures do not alter authorization, mutation, or audit outcomes
incident response, ADR, governance, and release approval requirements are validated by the operational readiness verifier
capabilities.evidence_gap: Hosts must configure production alert routes, retention schedules, and access controls for their selected log, metric, trace, audit, and compliance-export stores.

capabilities.name: companion_demo_application
guarantees: local Rails host consumes the engine by path dependency
tenant-scoped ticket workspace and policy-gated mutations
local-only read-only assistant with persisted trace events
seeded accounts demonstrate tenant and role behavior

compatibility.evidence_gap: Remote CI results must establish a passing history for every blocking lane; browser and independent generated-host coverage across the matrix remain pending.
